name: afterbells
description: The intent and execution router for tokenized stocks

scripts.demo: cd services/api && uv run python -m afterbells.demo
scripts.cli: cd services/api && uv run python -m afterbells.cli
scripts.mcp: cd services/api && uv run python -m afterbells.mcp_server
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @afterbells/web format:check && cd services/api && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.dev:api: cd services/api && uv run uvicorn afterbells.api.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @afterbells/web lint && cd services/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @afterbells/web typecheck && cd services/api && uv run mypy -p afterbells
scripts.verify:live: cd services/api && uv run python -m afterbells.verify_live
scripts.verify:mainnet-execution: cd services/api && uv run python -m afterbells.verify_execution --i-understand-mainnet
